cases.name: help_long
cases.stdout:
usage: canaryfield [-h] [--target TARGET] [--gate NAME=COMMAND]
                   [--plant {copy,git-branches}] [--write-seed-pack PATH]
                   [--out OUT] [--json] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                   [--work-root WORK_ROOT] [--keep-scratch]

Plant seeded defects into scratch copies of a target tree and score which
gates catch each one.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --target TARGET       target tree to copy and plant into
  --gate NAME=COMMAND   a named gate command, repeatable
  --plant {copy,git-branches}
                        planting mode, copy for scratch copies or git-branches
                        for a scratch clone
  --write-seed-pack PATH
                        write the canaryfield-seeds/10 seed pack to PATH and
                        exit
  --out OUT             directory to write catch-table.txt and catch-
                        table.json into
  --json                print the JSON report to stdout
  --timeout TIMEOUT     per gate run timeout in seconds
  --work-root WORK_ROOT
                        scratch directory root, defaults to a temp directory
  --keep-scratch        keep the scratch copies after the run
